arxiv-2012-14896.title: Self-consistent harmonic approximation with non-local couplings
arxiv-2012-14896.creator: Guido Giachetti, Nicolò Defenu, Stefano Ruffo, Andrea Trombettoni
arxiv-2012-14896.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Guido Giachetti, Nicolò Defenu, Stefano Ruffo, Andrea Trombettoni. We derive the self-consistent harmonic approximation for the 2 ​ D 2D XY model with non-local interactions. The resulting equation for the variational couplings holds for any form of the spin-spin coupling as well as for any dimension.

arxiv-2203-15587.title: RGB-D Neural Radiance Fields: Local Sampling for Faster Training
arxiv-2203-15587.creator: Arnab Dey, Andrew I. Comport
arxiv-2203-15587.description: Abstract Learning a 3D representation of a scene has been a challenging problem for decades in computer vision. Recent advances in implicit neural representation from images using neural radiance fields(NeRF) have shown promising results. Some of the limitations of previous NeRF based methods include longer training time, and inaccurate underlying geometry.

arxiv-2209-11426.title: The Beauty of Repetition in Machine Composition Scenarios Conference: Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia ; October 10–14, 2022; Lisboa, Portugal. Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’22), October 10–14, 2022, Lisboa, Portugal Price:
arxiv-2209-11426.creator: Zhejing Hu, Xiao Ma, Yan Liu, Gong Chen, Yongxu Liu
arxiv-2209-11426.description: Abstract . Repetition, a basic form of artistic creation, appears in most musical works and delivers enthralling aesthetic experiences. However, repetition remains underexplored in terms of automatic music composition. As an initial effort in repetition modelling, this paper focuses on generating motif-level repetitions via domain knowledge–based and example-based learning techniques.

arxiv-2212-13734.title: Solving local constraint condition problem in slave particle theory with the BRST quantization
arxiv-2212-13734.creator: Xi Luo 1, Jianqiao Liu 2, Yue Yu 2
arxiv-2212-13734.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xi Luo 1, Jianqiao Liu 2, Yue Yu 2. With the Becchi-Rouet-Stora-Tyutin (BRST) quantization of gauge theory, we solve the long-standing difficult problem of the local constraint conditions, i.e., the single occupation of a slave particle per site, in the slave particle theory.

arxiv-2305-13195.title: U-DiT TTS: U-Diffusion Vision Transformer for Text-to-Speech
arxiv-2305-13195.creator: Xin Jing 1 , Yi Chang 3 , Zijiang Yang 1 , Jiangjian Xie 2 , Andreas Triantafyllopoulos 1 , Björn W. Schuller 1,3
arxiv-2305-13195.description: Abstract Deep learning has led to considerable advances in text-to-speech synthesis. Most recently, the adoption of Score-based Generative Models (SGMs), also known as Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DPMs), has gained traction due to their ability to produce high-quality synthesized neural speech in neural speech synthesis systems.

arxiv-2310-01341.title: Two-dimensional ideal magnetohydrodynamic waves on a rotating sphere under a non-Malkus field: I. Continuous spectrum and its ray-theoretical interpretation
arxiv-2310-01341.creator: Ryosuke Nakashima † {{\dagger}}, Shigeo Yoshida ‡ {{\ddagger}} † {{\dagger}} Faculty of Science, Kyushu University, Fukuoka, Japan ‡ {{\ddagger}} Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences, Faculty of Science, Kyushu University, Fukuoka, Japan
arxiv-2310-01341.description: Abstract Two-dimensional ideal incompressible magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) linear waves at the surface of a rotating sphere are studied as a model to imitate the outermost layer of the Earth’s core or the solar tachocline. This thin conducting layer is permeated by a toroidal magnetic field the magnitude of which depends only on the latitude.

arxiv-2405-01274.title: Satellite lines from autoionizing states of Fe XVI and the problems with the X-ray Fe XVII lines
arxiv-2405-01274.creator: G. Del Zanna, N. R. Badnell, P. J. Storey
arxiv-2405-01274.description: Abstract We present new calculations of atomic data needed to model autoionizing states of Fe xvi . We compare the state energies, radiative and excitation data with a sample of results from previous literature. We find a large scatter of results, the most significant ones in the autoionization rates, which are very sensitive to the configuration interaction and state mixing.

arxiv-2405-07526.title: MS MARCO Web Search: a Large-scale Information-rich Web Dataset with Millions of Real Click Labels Conference: Companion Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2024; May 13–17, 2024; Singapore, Singapore Companion Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2024 (WWW ’24 Companion), May 13–17, 2024, Singap
arxiv-2405-07526.creator: Qi Chen, Xiubo Geng, Corby Rosset, Carolyn Buractaon, Jingwen Lu, Tao Shen, Kun Zhou, Chenyan Xiong ∗, Yeyun Gong, Paul Bennett ∗, Nick Craswell, Xing Xie, Fan Yang, Bryan Tower, Nikhil Rao, Anlei Dong, Wenqi Jiang †, Zheng Liu †, Mingqin Li †, Chuanjie Liu †, Zengzhong Li †, Rangan Majumder †, Jenn
arxiv-2405-07526.description: Abstract . Recent breakthroughs in large models have highlighted the critical significance of data scale, labels and modals. In this paper, we introduce MS MARCO Web Search, the first large-scale information-rich web dataset, featuring millions of real clicked query-document labels.

arxiv-2407-03090.title: Simulating the anharmonic phonon spectrum in critical systems: self-consistent phonons and temperature-dependent effective potential methods
arxiv-2407-03090.creator: Lorenzo Monacelli
arxiv-2407-03090.description: Abstract Understanding and simulating the thermodynamic and dynamical properties of materials affected by strong ionic anharmonicity is a central challenge in material science. Much interest is in material displaying critical displacive behaviour, such as near a ferroelectric transition, charge-density waves, or in general displacive second-order transitions.

arxiv-2503-12585.title: Varieties with free tangent sheaves
arxiv-2503-12585.creator: Damian Rössler, Stefan Schröer
arxiv-2503-12585.description: Abstract . We coin the term T T -trivial varieties to denote smooth proper schemes over ground fields k k whose tangent sheaf is free. Over the complex numbers, this are precisely the abelian varieties. However, Igusa observed that in characteristic p ≤ 3 p\leq 3 certain bielliptic surfaces are T T -trivial.

arxiv-2507-15786.title: A Robust COTS Objective for Diffraction-Limited, High-NA, Long Front Working Distance Imaging Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2507-15786.creator: Jiafeng Cui, 1,2,* Gilles Buchs, 1,2 and Christopher M. Seck 1,2,†
arxiv-2507-15786.description: Abstract We present a robust objective lens optimized for applications requiring both high numerical aperture (NA) and long front working distance imaging comprised of all commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) singlet lenses. Unlike traditional designs that require separate collimation and refocusing stages, our approach directly converges imaged light to the back focal plane using a single lens group.

arxiv-2511-07599.title: Prompt diphoton production at ATLAS 13 TeV in k t k_{t} -factorization: a comparative analysis of UPDF models
arxiv-2511-07599.creator: The CHROMA Collaboration: R. Kord Valeshabadi 1, S. Rezaie 1, K. Azizi 2,3,1
arxiv-2511-07599.description: Abstract We perform an in-depth comparative analysis of unintegrated parton distribution function (UPDF) models for isolated prompt diphoton production in proton–proton collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV within the k t k_{t} -factorization framework. Predictions are obtained with three UPDF approaches: Parton Branching (PB), NLO-MRW, and Modified KMRW (MKMRW). Tree-level q + q ¯ → γ + γ q+\bar{q}\!\to\!

arxiv-2511-13459.title: Contact-Safe Reinforcement Learning with ProMP Reparameterization and Energy Awareness
arxiv-2511-13459.creator: Bingkun Huang, Yuhe Gong, Zewen Yang, Tianyu Ren, Luis Figueredo
arxiv-2511-13459.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) approaches based on Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) are predominantly applied in the robot joint space, often relying on limited task-specific information and partial awareness of the 3D environment. In contrast, episodic RL has demonstrated advantages over traditional MDP-based methods in terms of trajectory consistency, task awareness, and overall performance in complex robotic tasks.

pmc-10630934.title: Proportional scaling molecular dynamics simulations of the wetting experiments of water droplets on ink-patterned printing paper†
pmc-10630934.creator: Xiao Wang, Lijun Chen, Chunlai Zhang, Xiping Zhang, Yintao Wu, Bo Wang
pmc-10630934.description: In experiments, printing paper is imprinted with three different ink micropatterns (square, grid, and stripe). The wetting contact angle of water droplets on a heterogeneous surface is then investigated using a proportionate scaling molecular dynamics (MD) simulation, where the water droplets and the ink-patterned printing paper are both shrunk by a factor of 200 000 collectively.

pmc-11416195.title: Treatment and Prognosis for Pancreatic Duct Disruption Associated With Pancreatic Cancer: A Case Series of 15 Patients
pmc-11416195.creator: Yuki Oka, Takeshi Tanaka, Takashi Kobayashi, Atsuhiro Masuda, Arata Sakai, Masahiro Tsujimae, Masanori Gonda, Hirochika Toyama, Takumi Fukumoto, Yuzo Kodama
pmc-11416195.description: BackgroundPancreatic duct (PD) disruption can occasionally be attributed to pancreatic cancer. Therapeutic interventions for PD disruption due to pancreatic cancer and their influence on pancreatic cancer prognosis remain unclear. This study investigated the therapeutic modalities and prognostic implications of PD disruption in pancreatic cancer.

pmc-12364431.title: A Multimodal Large Language Model as an End-to-End Classifier of Thyroid Nodule Malignancy Risk: Usability Study
pmc-12364431.creator: Gerald Gui Ren Sng, Yi Xiang, Daniel Yan Zheng Lim, Joshua Yi Min Tung, Jen Hong Tan, Chiaw Ling Chng, Javad Sarvestan
pmc-12364431.description: BackgroundThyroid nodules are common, with ultrasound imaging as the primary modality for their assessment. Risk stratification systems like the American College of Radiology Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System (ACR TI-RADS) have been developed but suffer from interobserver variability and low specificity. Artificial intelligence, particularly large language models (LLMs) with multimodal capabilities, presents opportunities for efficient end-to-end diagnostic processes.

pmc-12416668.title: Suicide rates in Germany in lockdown and non-lockdown phases during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020/2021
pmc-12416668.creator: Anne Elsner, Roland Mergl, Antje-Kathrin Allgaier, Ulrich Hegerl
pmc-12416668.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Contrary to the cautions of many, suicide rates during the first COVID-19 pandemic lockdown in Germany did not rise, but declined. With the accessibility of the 2021 weekly suicide data, it was possible to analyze suicide rates and the proportion of suicide methods during the lockdown and non-lockdown phases and during the first 21 months of the pandemic compared to the previous ten years. An interrupted time-series analysis based on a linear regression was used.

pmc-13130693.title: A study on metabolic differences between infectious and non-infectious stones in patients with urine culture positive for Proteus mirabilis
pmc-13130693.creator: Endi Zhang, Zhichao Chi, Xuming Zhang, Jianxing Li, Chaoyue Ji, Weiguo Hu
pmc-13130693.description: ObjectiveTo compare the clinical characteristics of infectious and non-infectious stones in patients with urinary tract infections caused by Proteus mirabilis and to explore associated influencing factors.MethodsClinical data from 93 patients with upper urinary tract stones and concomitant Proteus mirabilis urinary tract infection treated between 2015 and 2021 were retrospectively analyzed. Patients were classified according to postoperative stone composition.

pmc-13361363.title: Does Tuberculosis Leave a Thromboinflammatory Memory After Cure? A Narrative Review with a Conceptual Framework on Hypercoagulability, Cellular Reservoirs, and Extracellular Vesicle Signaling
pmc-13361363.creator: Ramona Cioboata, Silviu Gabriel Vlasceanu, Maria-Loredana Tieranu, Eugen Nicolae Tieranu, Mara Amalia Balteanu, Denisa Maria Mitroi, Anca Lelia Riza, Simona Daniela Neamtu, Adina Andreea Mirea
pmc-13361363.description: (TB) induces a pronounced thromboinflammatory state during active disease, characterized by elevated fibrinogen, D-dimer, and thrombin-related activity, reduced levels of endogenous anticoagulants, impaired fibrinolysis, platelet activation, and endothelial dysfunction. Although many of these abnormalities improve after treatment initiation, accumulating evidence suggests that microbiological cure may not fully restore vascular, immune, and hemostatic homeostasis.

pmc-13366205.title: Community‐Acquired Pneumococcal Ventriculitis as a Complication of Otogenic Pneumococcal Meningitis: A Case Report
pmc-13366205.creator: Marco Seneghini, Jonas Deppe, Alexis P R Terrapon, Philipp Balcerak, Georg Kägi, Werner C Albrich, Priya Gusain
pmc-13366205.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pyogenic ventriculitis is a rare and potentially fatal infection of the ventricular system. While most reported cases are nosocomial and catheter‐associated, ventriculitis as a complication of community‐acquired bacterial meningitis is uncommon, particularly in adults, and carries a poor prognosis. We report the case of an 82‐year‐old previously healthy and unvaccinated woman who presented with a one‐day history of fever, confusion, and purulent left‐sided otorrhea on a 2‐week background of flu‐like symptoms.

pmc-13387385.title: Are Real-World Mobility Patterns Early Indicators of COPD Onset? Insights from Wrist-Worn Sensors
pmc-13387385.creator: Nelida Fernandez, Arnold Y L Wong, Matthew A Brodie, Kimberley S Van Schooten, Lloyd L Y Chan, Stephen R Lord
pmc-13387385.description: BackgroundChronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a leading cause of disability and death worldwide. Early identification remains challenging, as existing prediction models largely rely on clinic-based assessments and self-report measures that are resource-intensive and prone to bias. This study aimed to determine whether real-world mobility metrics could predict incident COPD.
